# FoxData App Store Data API — Content Hub

This repository is a content and code hub for the FoxData App Store Data API, which provides iOS (App Store) and Google Play app data across 200+ countries.

## What the API provides

- Downloads, revenue and ranking estimates per country
- Keyword coverage and search demand index
- Competitor lists, ratings, review velocity and version logs
- Apple Search Ads (ASA) bid keywords with correlation scores

## Key pages

- [README](README.md) — overview, quick start, data types
- [API docs](https://docs.foxdata.com/) — authentication (x-openapi-key), endpoints, error codes
- [Content Library](content/articles/) — 17 data-driven articles with reproducible code
